verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud marketing says it helps users understand production systems using natural language and lists an AI-powered Grafana Assistant, so the product does claim its own natural-language capability. Nothing shows that a question returns a generated PromQL/LogQL query or a chart, and the MCP server and Knowledge Graph's 'no complex queries required' insights are adjacent features rather than natural-language-to-query. missing for 10: documentation that natural-language questions produce real queries, chart or panel generation from prompts, details on supported data sources and query languages, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can ask questions of my telemetry in natural language and get a real query or chart back

citations.quote: Understand production systems faster using natural language
Includes AI-powered capabilities for engineering teams, including Grafana Assistant, Investigations, Agent Observability, and more.
